summary.text: Derek Tran is the Democratic incumbent seeking re-election in California's 45th District, first elected in 2024 when he defeated Republican incumbent Michelle Steel. The son of Vietnamese refugees, he is an Army Reserve veteran, consumer-rights attorney and co-owner of an independent pharmacy. He serves on the House Armed Services and Small Business Committees.

paragraphs.text: Tran was born and raised in Los Angeles County; according to his official biography, his parents came to the United States from Vietnam in early 1980 after his father fled following the fall of Saigon in 1975.

He enlisted in the U.S. Army Reserve at 18 and served eight years, including activation for Operation Noble Eagle and Enduring Freedom, before an honorable discharge, according to his official biography; Ballotpedia lists the branch as U.S. Army.
He earned a B.S. in Economics-Finance from Bentley University and a Juris Doctor from Glendale University College of Law, and moved to Orange County in 2012.
Tran worked as an attorney representing consumers and workers and served on the board of the Consumer Attorneys Association of Los Angeles and California, according to his official biography.

The biography also says he worked on public safety policy for the Mayor of Los Angeles and served as a traffic commissioner for the City of Orange, and that he co-owns an independent pharmacy with his wife, Michelle; the couple have three children.
Tran won the 45th District seat in the November 5, 2024 general election, defeating incumbent Republican Michelle Steel, and took office in 2025.
In his first term he serves on the House Armed Services Committee and the House Small Business Committee.
